name: Zurzoth, Chaos Rider
oracle_text:
Whenever an opponent draws their first card each turn, if it's not their turn, you create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
Whenever one or more Devils you control attack one or more players, you and those players each draw a card, then discard a card at random.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more Devils you control attack one or more players, you and those players each draw a card, then discard a card at random.

needs.what: a binding, fixed as the trigger fires, of the players the matching attackers (the Devils you control) attack directly, so one batched 'one or more Devils you control attack one or more players' trigger can say 'you and those players each draw a card, then discard a card at random' with you drawing exactly once
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The trigger half is expressible: you_attack fires once per declaration and a condition {exists: {binding: attackers, subtypes: [Devil], attacking_player: any}} with recheck: false filters it to a Devil attacking a player. The missing half is 'those players'. you_attack's attacked_players binding is every seat attacked directly, so in a pod a player attacked only by a non-Devil would draw and discard too. Narrowing it at resolution (for_each_player over attacked_players with an exists-Devil-attacking_player-{binding} check) reads combat live and drops a player whose Devil died or left combat before resolution, which the printed ability does not. creatures_attack_player binds the per-defender attackers but fires once per defending player, so you would draw and discard once per attacked player. {attacked_by} only accepts self. The first sentence is expressible now that devil_1_1_r exists (draw with nth 1, controller opponent, condition not is_active_player of the event player).
